evidence_excerpts: The thalamocortical system is organized in a way that appears to emphasize at once both functional specialization and functional integration.

Connection matrices yielding the highest values of information integration (Φ = 74 bits) share two key characteristics: connection patterns are different for different elements, and all elements can be reached from all other elements.
text: A distributed thalamocortical network is well suited to generate consciousness because it combines functional specialization with functional integration.
